The '''Taanab system''' contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]]. [[Norulac]] was located nearby. The Taanab [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. There was a [[Jedi chapter house (Taanab)/Legends|Jedi chapter house]] in system on Taanab.
